Cross-fitted classification probabilities for every group of a tree

Source: R/crossfit.R
crossfitLineageProbabilities.Rd

An alternative to bootstrapLineageConfidence(): for each group with children, a classifier is trained on the group's cells with balanced classes and gives each cell the probability of each child cell type. The cells are split into nFolds folds and each fold is scored by a classifier trained on the other folds, so no cell is scored by a classifier that saw it. Because the classes are balanced in training, the probabilities give every child cell type the same prior weight.

Usage

crossfitLineageProbabilities(
  spe,
  cellTypeTree,
  nFolds = 5,
  nPerClass = 50,
  seed = 51773,
  classifier = c("pcaLogistic", "logistic", "rf", "lda"),
  ntree = 500,
  priors = c("balanced", "observed"),
  cores = 1,
  skipGroups = character(0),
  cellType = "cellType",
  cellID = "cellID",
  assayName = "counts"
)

Arguments

spe

A SummarizedExperiment (e.g. SpatialExperiment) with a counts assay and per-cell cell type labels and unique cell IDs in colData.

cellTypeTree

A cell type tree, see cellTypeTree.

nFolds

Number of folds. The folds are stratified by cell type, so every fold's classifier is trained on every child cell type; each child cell type therefore needs at least 2 cells.

nPerClass

Minimum number of training cells per class; classes smaller than this are up-sampled with replacement.

seed

Random seed, or NULL for no fixed seed. Each group is bootstrapped with seed plus its position in the list of groups, so every group is reproducible independently of the others.

classifier

"pcaLogistic" (the default), "logistic", "rf" or "lda", as in bootstrapClassify().

ntree

Number of trees; only used when classifier = "rf".

priors

"balanced" (equal priors, as the classifier is trained) or "observed" (each class weighted by its share of the group's cells).

cores

Number of cores to fit the folds on in parallel, as in bootstrapClassify().

skipGroups

Names of groups to leave out of the result.

cellType

Name of the colData(spe) column holding each cell's cell type label.

cellID

Name of the colData(spe) column holding unique cell IDs. They are returned in the cellID column of each result.

assayName

Name of the assay with the raw counts.

Value

A confidence list in the format of bootstrapLineageConfidence(), with probabilities in place of bootstrap confidences.

Examples

data(lungSubset)
data(lungCellTypeTree)
probList = crossfitLineageProbabilities(lungSubset, lungCellTypeTree,
    nFolds = 3, seed = 1)
#> [1/10] Lineage: Macrophage lineage done
#> [2/10] Lineage: Dendritic cells done
#> [3/10] Lineage: Granulocytes done
#> [4/10] Lineage: T cells done
#> [6/10] Lineage: B lineage done
#> [7/10] Lineage: Fibroblast lineage done
#> [8/10] Lineage: Endothelial lineage done
#> [9/10] Lineage: Alveolar done
#> [10/10] Lineage: Airway done
head(probList[["Endothelial lineage"]])
